realms.name: Principality of Wallachia
realms.title: Voivode
realms.situation: Mircea held the Danube against Bayezid at Rovine and survived him. With the Ottomans broken at Ankara he means to take back the Dobruja and the Danube fords, and to make and unmake sultans in the coming civil war, while keeping Hungary a friend and not a master.

notable.event: Mircea retakes the Dobruja and Silistra
Mircea backs Musa Çelebi for the Ottoman throne
Mircea dies; the long feud of the Dănești and the Drăculești begins
Vlad III, the Impaler, takes the throne

realms.uncertain: Wallachia's standing with the Ottomans in 1402 is debated: Mircea had paid tribute after 1395 but stopped after Ankara. He also held Făgăraș and Amlaș as Hungarian fiefs.

realms.name: Principality of Moldavia
realms.title: Voivode
realms.situation: Alexander swore homage to Władysław Jagiełło at Suceava in March 1402. Moldavia's wealth is the trade road from Lwów to Cetatea Albă and Chilia; its church was just recognised by Constantinople. Hungary and Poland both want it as their march against the steppe.

notable.event: Homage to the King of Poland at Suceava
Moldavian troops fight for Poland at Grunwald
Alexander dies; years of war between his sons follow
Stephen the Great takes the throne

realms.uncertain: Alexander's year of birth is not known.

realms.name: Kingdom of Hungary
realms.title: King
realms.situation: Sigismund was held prisoner by his own barons in 1401 and many of them now call Ladislaus of Naples to the throne. He must win back his kingdom, then turn to the Ottoman danger he failed to stop at Nicopolis, and to Dalmatia, which Venice covets.

notable.event: Ladislaus of Naples is crowned at Zara; the rebel barons are crushed
Sigismund founds the Order of the Dragon
Sigismund is elected King of the Romans
John Hunyadi breaks the Ottoman siege of Belgrade

realms.uncertain: In 1402 Sigismund named Albert IV of Austria his heir; Albert died in 1404 and the pact lapsed.

realms.name: County of Krk, Senj and Modruš
realms.title: Count
realms.situation: The Frankopans are the greatest lords of the Croatian coast, from Krk to Modruš. Nikola weighs Sigismund against Ladislaus of Naples and means to come out of the civil war richer.

notable.event: Nikola becomes Ban of Croatia and Dalmatia
Nikola marries his daughter to the Despot of Serbia's heir
The Frankopan lands are divided among Nikola's sons

realms.name: Republic of Ragusa
realms.title: Rector
realms.situation: Ragusa lives by the caravans to the Serbian and Bosnian silver mines and by the sea. It pays its tribute to the King of Hungary, buys land from its neighbours when it can, and stays at peace with everyone.

notable.event: Ragusa buys Konavle from Sandalj Hranić
Ragusa begins to pay tribute to the Ottoman sultan

realms.uncertain: The Rector served for one month at a time: the 'ruler' is the republic itself.

realms.name: Duchy of Austria
realms.title: Duke
realms.situation: The Habsburg lands are split between the Albertine line at Vienna and the Leopoldine dukes in Styria, Carinthia and Carniola. Albert IV has just been named heir to Hungary by Sigismund.

notable.event: Albert IV dies; his son Albert V succeeds as a child
Albert V is crowned King of Hungary and Bohemia
Austria becomes an archduchy

realms.uncertain: Duke William of the Leopoldine line ruled Inner Austria (Graz, Carinthia, Carniola, Trieste) in his own right; the game folds his lands into one realm.

realms.name: County of Celje
realms.title: Count
realms.situation: Hermann saved Sigismund's life at Nicopolis and is his closest friend. The Counts of Celje rise through marriages: Hermann's cousin Anna has just wed the King of Poland, his daughter Barbara will marry Sigismund.

notable.event: Barbara of Celje marries Sigismund
The counts are made princes of the Empire
Ulrich II of Celje is murdered at Belgrade and the house dies out

realms.uncertain: Celje's lands lay in Styria under the Habsburgs, but its counts acted as Sigismund's men.

realms.name: Patriarchate of Aquileia
realms.title: Patriarch
realms.situation: The patriarchs rule Friuli as princes of the Empire, squeezed between Venice and the Counts of Gorizia. Antonio Panciera has just been named patriarch.

notable.event: Panciera is deposed; Friuli is fought over by Sigismund and Venice
Venice conquers Friuli and ends the patriarchs' rule

realms.name: Prince-Archbishopric of Salzburg
realms.title: Archbishop
realms.situation: The archbishops grow rich on the salt of Hallein and keep their see free of the Bavarian and Austrian dukes.

notable.event: Eberhard III von Neuhaus becomes archbishop

realms.name: Duchy of Bavaria-Landshut
realms.title: Duke
realms.situation: Young Henry is the richest of the Wittelsbach dukes and quarrels with his cousins of Ingolstadt.

notable.event: Henry defeats Ingolstadt at Alling
Henry dies; Louis IX the Rich succeeds

realms.name: Kingdom of Bohemia
realms.title: King
realms.situation: Deposed as King of the Romans in 1400, Wenceslaus was seized in March 1402 by his brother Sigismund and is held prisoner in Vienna. Prague is restless, and Jan Hus is preaching.

notable.event: Wenceslaus escapes captivity and returns to Prague
Jan Hus is burned at Constance
The defenestration of Prague: the Hussite wars begin
George of Poděbrady is elected king

realms.name: Margraviate of Moravia
realms.title: Margrave
realms.situation: Jobst is the shrewdest of the Luxembourgs and a creditor of half Europe; his brother and co-margrave Prokop is Sigismund's prisoner.

notable.event: Prokop dies in Sigismund's prison
Jobst is elected King of the Romans
Jobst dies; Moravia passes to Wenceslaus

realms.name: Kingdom of Poland
realms.title: King
realms.situation: Widowed of Queen Jadwiga, Jagiełło married Anna of Celje in January 1402 to keep his crown. His great enemy is the Teutonic Order; to the south he collects the homage of Moldavia.

notable.event: Poland and Lithuania crush the Teutonic Order at Grunwald
The Union of Horodło
Władysław III falls at Varna
The Thirteen Years' War against the Order begins

realms.name: Grand Duchy of Lithuania
realms.title: Grand Duke
realms.situation: Vytautas rules the steppe frontier to the Black Sea, but his crusade against the Tatars ended in disaster at the Vorskla in 1399. He bargains with Poland for his crown and with the Horde's khans for the steppe.

notable.event: Vytautas leads the Lithuanians at Grunwald
The Congress of Lutsk
Vytautas dies before he can be crowned king

realms.uncertain: Vilnius lies off the map; Lutsk, one of his residences, stands in as the capital.

realms.name: Golden Horde
realms.title: Khan
realms.situation: The khans are puppets of the beklerbek Edigu, who crushed Vytautas at the Vorskla. The Horde still claims tribute from Moscow and the Lithuanian lands, but Timur's wars have broken its cities and its trade.

notable.event: Shadi Beg is overthrown
Edigu besieges Moscow
Hacı Giray founds the Khanate of Crimea

realms.uncertain: Edigu, not the khan, held power; he is the Horde's real master in 1402.

realms.name: Principality of Theodoro
realms.title: Prince
realms.situation: A small Orthodox principality in the Crimean mountains, heir of the Byzantine Gothia. Its princes compete with the Genoese of Caffa for the southern coast and want a port of their own.

notable.event: Alexios builds the harbour fortress of Kalamita
War with Genoa over Cembalo
The Ottomans take Mangup and end the principality

realms.uncertain: Alexios's predecessor Stephen left for Moscow either in 1391 or in 1402.

realms.name: Genoese Gazaria and the Levant
realms.title: Governor
realms.situation: Genoa is under the lordship of the King of France, governed by Marshal Boucicaut. Its colonies - Caffa, Chios, Famagusta, Chilia, Amasra - live from the Black Sea grain and slave trade and are Venice's bitter rivals.

notable.event: Boucicaut raids the Levant and is beaten by Venice at Modon
Genoa throws off French rule
The Ottomans take Caffa

realms.uncertain: The city of Genoa lies off the map: the realm is its eastern colonies, seated at Caffa.

realms.name: Circassia
realms.title: Prince
realms.situation: The Circassian princes rule the Kuban and the Kabarda valleys, raid the steppe and sell slaves and horses through the Genoese ports.

notable.event: Inal unites much of Circassia, by tradition

realms.uncertain: Inal is known mostly from tradition and his dates are disputed; the Circassians' faith mixed old Christianity and their own gods.

realms.name: Republic of Venice
realms.title: Doge
realms.situation: Venice holds the sea road to the Levant: Crete, Negroponte, Modon and Coron, Corfu, Durazzo and Scutari. With the Ottomans broken it wants Dalmatia back from Hungary, the Terraferma from the Carrara of Padua, and safe trade with whoever wins in Edirne.

notable.event: Venice takes Padua, Vicenza and Verona
Venice buys Zara and Dalmatia from Ladislaus of Naples
Venice takes Thessaloniki from the Byzantines
The Peace of Lodi

realms.name: Papal States
realms.title: Pope
realms.situation: The Church is split between popes in Rome and Avignon. Boniface rebuilds his authority in Rome and the Papal States with the help of Ladislaus of Naples.

notable.event: Boniface IX dies
The Council of Constance ends the Schism
Pius II calls a crusade at Mantua

realms.name: Kingdom of Naples
realms.title: King
realms.situation: Ladislaus has won back his kingdom from the Angevins of Provence and now claims Hungary, where Sigismund's barons call him in. He dreams of ruling all of Italy.

notable.event: Ladislaus is crowned King of Hungary at Zara
Ladislaus occupies Rome
Ladislaus dies; Joanna II succeeds
Alfonso of Aragon conquers Naples

realms.name: Kingdom of Sicily
realms.title: King
realms.situation: Martin the Younger has subdued the Sicilian barons with Aragonese help and just married Blanche of Navarre. Sicily is bound ever closer to the crown of Aragon.

notable.event: Martin I wins at Sanluri in Sardinia and dies of fever
Sicily passes to the Trastámara kings of Aragon

realms.name: Ottoman Rumelia
realms.title: Emir
realms.situation: Bayezid's eldest son escaped from Ankara and holds the European half of the empire from Edirne. He buys peace from the Christians to fight his brothers in Anatolia.

notable.event: The Treaty of Gallipoli: Thessaloniki and the coast are given back to Byzantium
Süleyman is overthrown and killed by his brother Musa
Mehmed defeats Musa at Çamurlu and reunites the empire
Mehmed II takes Constantinople

realms.name: Byzantine Empire
realms.title: Emperor
realms.situation: Ankara saved the City from Bayezid's siege. Manuel is still in the West begging for help; his nephew John VII rules Constantinople and will win back Thessaloniki and the Black Sea coast from Süleyman.

notable.event: Manuel returns; the Treaty of Gallipoli restores Thessaloniki
Murad II besieges Constantinople
The Union of the Churches at Florence
Constantinople falls to Mehmed II

realms.uncertain: Manuel II was in the West until 1403; John VII governed the City in his absence.

realms.name: Despotate of the Morea
realms.title: Despot
realms.situation: Theodore sold Corinth to the Knights of Rhodes in his fear of Bayezid and now wants it back. The Latin principality of Achaea and the Navarrese are his rivals for the peninsula.

notable.event: Corinth is bought back from the Knights
Theodore I dies
The Hexamilion wall is built across the Isthmus
Mehmed II conquers the Morea

realms.name: Principality of Achaea
realms.title: Prince
realms.situation: The last Frankish principality of the Morea is held by the captains of the Navarrese Company. It is squeezed between the Despot of Mystras and Venice's ports.

notable.event: Pedro dies in November; his widow Maria Zaccaria rules as regent
Centurione II Zaccaria becomes prince
The Palaiologoi conquer the last of Achaea

realms.name: Duchy of Athens
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: The Florentine bastard son of Nerio Acciaioli holds Thebes and is besieging the Venetians on the Acropolis of Athens, which his father had left to the Republic.

notable.event: Antonio takes the Acropolis and Athens from Venice
Antonio dies
The Ottomans take Athens

realms.name: Despotate of Epirus
realms.title: Despot
realms.situation: A Florentine despot of Ioannina among Albanian clans. Esau holds on with Ottoman help against the Spata of Arta and the Zenebishi.

notable.event: Esau dies; Carlo Tocco takes Ioannina
Ioannina submits to the Ottomans

realms.name: Despotate of Arta
realms.title: Despot
realms.situation: The Albanian lords of Arta live by war with Ioannina and Carlo Tocco.

notable.event: Muriq and Zenebishi invade Epirus
Carlo Tocco takes Arta

realms.uncertain: Some sources date Muriq's rule from 1403.

realms.name: County Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos
realms.title: Count
realms.situation: The Neapolitan lords of the Ionian islands look across the strait to Epirus, its Albanian despots and its towns.

notable.event: Carlo takes Ioannina
Carlo takes Arta
Ioannina falls to the Ottomans

realms.name: Knights Hospitaller
realms.title: Grand Master
realms.situation: The Knights of Rhodes hold the castle of Smyrna and, since 1400, Corinth. Timur's armies are near Smyrna; Corinth must be returned to the Despot.

notable.event: Timur takes Smyrna from the Knights in December
The Knights begin the castle of Bodrum
The Mamluks besiege Rhodes

realms.name: Lordship of Lesbos
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: Genoese lords married into the imperial house, holding Lesbos and Ainos as vassals of the emperor and living from the alum and grain trade.

notable.event: Francesco II dies
Mehmed II takes Mytilene

realms.name: Duchy of the Archipelago
realms.title: Duke
realms.situation: A Latin duchy of the Cyclades under Venice's protection, plagued by Turkish corsairs.

notable.event: Giacomo I dies
The duchy becomes an Ottoman tributary

realms.name: Kingdom of Cyprus
realms.title: King
realms.situation: The Lusignan kings want Famagusta back from the Genoese and fear the Mamluks, whose coasts their ships raid.

notable.event: The Mamluks invade; Janus is captured at Khirokitia
Cyprus becomes a Mamluk tributary
Venice takes Cyprus

realms.name: Despotate of Serbia
realms.title: Despot
realms.situation: Stefan fought for Bayezid at Ankara and came home through Constantinople with the title of Despot. He wants to be free of the Ottomans and master of the Serbian lands, and the Brankovićs stand in his way.

notable.event: Stefan defeats the Brankovićs and the Ottomans at Tripolje (November)
Stefan becomes Sigismund's vassal and receives Belgrade
Stefan dies; Đurađ Branković succeeds
The Ottomans take Smederevo

realms.name: Lands of the Brankovići
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: The sons of Vuk Branković hold Kosovo, Peć and Prizren as Ottoman vassals and refuse the Despot's rule; Đurađ was briefly Stefan's prisoner after Ankara.

notable.event: The Brankovićs lose to Stefan at Tripolje
Đurađ reconciles with Stefan, his uncle
Đurađ becomes Despot of Serbia

realms.name: Kingdom of Bosnia
realms.title: King
realms.situation: Ostoja reigns at the pleasure of the great magnates, Hrvoje above all. He wavers between Sigismund and Ladislaus of Naples.

notable.event: The magnates depose Ostoja for Tvrtko II
Ostoja returns to the throne
The Ottomans conquer Bosnia

realms.name: Lands of Hrvoje Vukčić
realms.title: Grand Duke
realms.situation: The mightiest man in Bosnia makes and unmakes kings. He backs Ladislaus of Naples, who will make him Duke of Split.

notable.event: Ladislaus makes Hrvoje Duke of Split
Hrvoje goes over to Sigismund
Hrvoje calls in the Ottomans against Hungary
Hrvoje dies

realms.uncertain: Hrvoje's faith is debated: he patronised both the Bosnian Church and Catholics.

realms.name: Lands of Sandalj Hranić
realms.title: Grand Duke
realms.situation: Sandalj rules Hum and the hills behind Ragusa, and plays the Bosnian king, Hrvoje, Ragusa and the Ottomans against each other.

notable.event: Sandalj marries Jelena, the Despot's sister
Sandalj sells Konavle to Ragusa
His nephew Stjepan takes the title Herceg: Herzegovina

realms.name: Lands of Pavle Radinović
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: The lord of Borač and its silver mines, at Sandalj's elbow and in his way.

notable.event: Pavle is murdered at Sandalj's instigation
The Ottomans take the Pavlović lands

realms.name: Lordship of Zeta
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: The Balšići have lost Scutari to Venice and want it back. Đurađ is ailing; his son Balša will fight Venice for the coast.

notable.event: Đurađ II dies; Balša III succeeds
The first Scutari war against Venice
Balša III dies and leaves Zeta to the Despot of Serbia

realms.name: Lordship of Kruja
realms.title: Lady
realms.situation: Karl Thopia's daughter holds Kruja with Venetian backing; her half-brother Niketa wants it.

notable.event: Niketa Thopia takes Kruja from Helena
Kruja falls to the Ottomans

realms.uncertain: Helena's first husband, the Venetian Marco Barbarigo, ruled in her name; Venice's protection is the game's reading of that.

realms.name: Lordship of Kastrioti
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: Gjon holds Mat and Dibra between the Ottomans and Venice, switching faith and allegiance as he must. His youngest son, George, will be born in 1405.

notable.event: George Kastrioti, Skanderbeg, is born
Skanderbeg rises against the Ottomans
The League of Lezhë

realms.uncertain: When Gjon began to rule is not known exactly.

realms.name: Lordship of Dukagjini
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: The Dukagjini hold the mountains behind Lezhë and treat with Venice over the town.

notable.event: The Dukagjini join the League of Lezhë

realms.uncertain: Lekë Dukagjini's sons Progon and Tanush shared the lordship; dates are approximate.

realms.name: Lordship of Arianiti
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: The Arianiti hold the mountains of Shpat between the Shkumbin and Ohrid.

notable.event: Gjergj Arianiti rises against the Ottomans
His daughter Donika marries Skanderbeg

realms.uncertain: Komnen Arianiti's dates are approximate.

realms.name: Lordship of Berat
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: The Muzaka hold Berat and the plain of Myzeqe, the richest corner of Albania.

notable.event: The Ottomans take Berat
Teodor rises against the Ottomans

realms.name: Principality of Valona
realms.title: Lady
realms.situation: The widow of Mrkša Žarković holds Valona and Kanina, and offers them to Venice in turn.

notable.event: Regina dies
The Ottomans take Valona

realms.name: Lordship of Gjirokastër
realms.title: Lord
realms.situation: The lord of Gjirokastër raids Epirus and once held Esau of Ioannina for ransom.

notable.event: Zenebishi and the Spata invade Epirus
Gjin Zenebishi dies
The Ottomans take Gjirokastër

realms.name: Ottomans of Bursa
realms.title: Çelebi
realms.situation: After Timur's men sacked Bursa, Bayezid's son İsa took the old capital and calls himself sultan. His brothers Mehmed and Süleyman both want it.

notable.event: Mehmed defeats İsa at Ulubad
İsa is killed

realms.name: Ottomans of Amasya
realms.title: Çelebi
realms.situation: The youngest of Bayezid's free sons holds Amasya and Tokat, far from Timur's reach. He is patient, and he means to have the whole empire.

notable.event: Mehmed takes Bursa from İsa
Mehmed reunites the empire as Mehmed I
Mehmed I dies; Murad II succeeds

realms.name: Beylik of Candar
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: Timur gave İsfendiyar back Kastamonu. He holds Sinop's harbour and copper mines and wants to keep the Ottomans divided.

notable.event: Mehmed I takes Çankırı from İsfendiyar
The Ottomans annex the beylik

realms.name: Beylik of Germiyan
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: Restored by Timur to his old lands around Kütahya, Yakub is a poet and a schemer who fears both the Ottomans and Karaman.

notable.event: Yakub is imprisoned by Karaman
Yakub leaves Germiyan to the Ottomans

realms.name: Beylik of Saruhan
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: Restored by Timur, the last Saruhanid holds Manisa and the alum of the Hermus valley.

notable.event: Mehmed Çelebi kills Hızır Şah and takes Saruhan

realms.name: Beylik of Aydın
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: Timur gave the brothers İsa and Umur back the coast of Ephesus and Smyrna; the adventurer Cüneyd waits for his chance.

notable.event: Cüneyd seizes the beylik
The Ottomans annex Aydın

realms.name: Beylik of Menteşe
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: Restored by Timur, İlyas holds Milas and the coast facing Rhodes, and trades with Venice.

notable.event: İlyas dies
The Ottomans annex Menteşe

realms.name: Beylik of Teke
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: Osman is back in the hills of Elmalı and wants Antalya, the great port his family lost to Bayezid.

notable.event: Osman is killed besieging Antalya

realms.uncertain: Whether Antalya itself was in Teke's or Ottoman hands in 1402 is unclear.

realms.name: Beylik of Karaman
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: Freed by Timur, the sons of Alaeddin Ali are back in Konya with a few more fortresses. Karaman claims the heritage of the Seljuks and is the Ottomans' oldest enemy.

notable.event: Mehmed of Karaman takes and burns Bursa
Mehmed dies besieging Antalya
The Ottomans annex Karaman

realms.name: Beylik of Ramazan
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: The Turkmen lords of Adana guard the Mamluks' northern march in Cilicia.

notable.event: Ahmed takes Tarsus from Karaman
Ahmed dies

realms.name: Beylik of Dulkadir
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: The Turkmen of Elbistan and Maraş balance between the Mamluks and the Ottomans and marry their daughters to both.

notable.event: Mehmed marries a daughter to Mehmed Çelebi
Nasireddin Mehmed dies

realms.name: Empire of Trebizond
realms.title: Emperor
realms.situation: Manuel bowed to Timur and sent him ships. Trebizond lives from the silk road's end and its Genoese and Venetian merchants.

notable.event: Manuel III dies
Mehmed II takes Trebizond

realms.name: Timurid Empire
realms.title: Emir
realms.situation: The conqueror has broken the Ottomans and his armies winter in western Anatolia. He has restored the beyliks as his vassals; in the east he holds Erzincan, Erzurum and Mardin through his vassals. He will soon turn back towards China.

notable.event: Timur takes Smyrna from the Knights in December
Timur leaves Anatolia; Bayezid dies a prisoner
Timur dies on his way to China

realms.uncertain: Timur's capital, Samarkand, is far off the map; Erzincan stands in for his eastern vassals.

realms.name: Aq Qoyunlu
realms.title: Bey
realms.situation: The White Sheep Turkmen fought for Timur at Ankara and were given Diyarbakır. Their enemies are the Black Sheep of Qara Yusuf.

notable.event: Qara Osman falls in battle against the Qara Qoyunlu
Uzun Hasan destroys the Qara Qoyunlu

realms.uncertain: Qara Osman led the confederation in fact before he was its formal head.

realms.name: Kingdom of Georgia
realms.title: King
realms.situation: Georgia has been ravaged by Timur's eight invasions and still resists. The king wants his land rebuilt and his vassals in the west kept loyal.

notable.event: George VII falls fighting the Qara Qoyunlu
Alexander I begins to rebuild
The kingdom splits into Kartli, Kakheti and Imereti

realms.uncertain: Tbilisi lies just off the map; Kutaisi stands in as the capital.

realms.name: Mamluk Sultanate
realms.title: Sultan
realms.situation: The boy sultan's Syria was sacked by Timur in 1400-1401: Aleppo and Damascus burned. The emirs fight over the regency while the Turkmen of the north drift away.

notable.event: Faraj is briefly deposed
Faraj is killed in Damascus
The Mamluks defeat and capture King Janus of Cyprus at Khirokitia

realms.uncertain: Cairo lies far off the map; Aleppo stands in as the capital. The Mamluk elite were Circassians and Turks ruling an Arab country.

relations.note: Ladislaus of Naples claims the Hungarian crown against Sigismund.
Sigismund holds his brother King Wenceslaus prisoner.
Sigismund holds his cousin Prokop prisoner; Jobst wants him back.
Sigismund has named Albert IV of Austria his heir.
Hermann of Celje is Sigismund's closest friend.
The Polish-Lithuanian union, renewed at Vilnius and Radom in 1401.
Władysław Jagiełło married Anna of Celje in January 1402.
Alexander of Moldavia swore homage to Poland in March 1402.
Edigu crushed Vytautas at the Vorskla in 1399.
The old enemies of the Levant trade; war will flare at Modon in 1403.
Venice wants Dalmatia back from the crown of Hungary.
The Balšići want back Scutari, which they sold to Venice in 1396.
Hrvoje backs Ladislaus of Naples for the crown of Hungary.
Stefan Lazarević and the Brankovićs fight for Serbia; Tripolje is near.
Đurađ Balšić is married to Stefan Lazarević's sister Jelena.
The sons of Bayezid fight for his throne.
İsa and Mehmed will fight for Bursa within the year.
Süleyman must buy peace from the Christians he can no longer frighten; the Treaty of Gallipoli is coming.
The Despot of the Morea is the emperor's brother.
The Despot wants Corinth back from the Knights.
Karaman is the Ottomans' oldest enemy in Anatolia.
Timur sacked Aleppo and Damascus in 1400-1401.
Timur's armies have invaded Georgia again and again.
Timur's armies march on the Knights' castle at Smyrna.
The Genoese hold Famagusta, the kingdom's great port.
The Despot of Ioannina and the Spata of Arta fight over Epirus.
Carlo Tocco has his eyes on Arta.
Antonio Acciaioli besieges the Venetians on the Acropolis.
